items.prompt: What is the passive participle of this verb?
items.explanation: From the bare verb, the passive participle is on mafʿūl: maktūb.

items.prompt: How does the first word differ from the second?
options: The fatḥa before the last letter makes the first passive: honoured
items.explanation: Fatḥa before the last letter: passive participle; kasra: active participle.

items.prompt: On which pattern is the passive participle of the bare verb?
items.explanation: Manṣūr, maḍrūb, maktūb: all on mafʿūl.
